subject: Proposed rotating schedule for technical deep dive / next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@medilabs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 22:12:00 +0000
Subject: Proposed rotating schedule for technical deep dive / next steps

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the conversation today — great to learn more about MediLabs' model-hosting constraints and the latency SLAs you're targeting.

Quick recap:
- Primary goal: run a 60–90 minute technical deep dive (model architecture, infra, and integration) for engineering + platform teams
- Key constraints: APAC region customers need at least one slot during local business hours; EU infra team prefers early mornings UTC
- Success metric for next call: agreement on recurring deep-dive cadence and SE availability for integration planning

To make calendar coordination easy across US/EU/APAC, we prototyped a 3-week rotating slot schedule (each week a different regional-friendly window). Please see three options below — times are listed in UTC with local examples.

Option A — Rotation by week (preferred for predictable coverage)
- Week 1 (US-friendly): Tue 17:00–18:30 UTC (12:00–13:30 ET / 17:00–18:30 BST / 03:00–04:30 AEST)
- Week 2 (EU-friendly): Tue 08:00–09:30 UTC (04:00–05:30 ET / 09:00–10:30 BST / 18:00–19:30 AEST)
- Week 3 (APAC-friendly): Tue 00:00–01:30 UTC (19:00–20:30 ET prev day / 00:00–01:30 BST / 10:00–11:30 AEST)

Option B — Fixed weekday, rotating time windows (less disruption for calendar blocks)
- Week 1: Tue 17:00–18:30 UTC
- Week 2: Tue 08:00–09:30 UTC
- Week 3: Tue 00:00–01:30 UTC

Option C — Biweekly alternating US/APAC with an occasional EU mid-week slot
- US slot every other week + APAC slot alternate; EU slot month once

Ask: can you confirm which option (A/B/C) looks best for your team and whether Tue works as the anchor day? Also, can Maria (cc'd on your side) confirm preferred windows for the Platform engineers? Finally, can we lock Dev Patel (our SE) for one of the first two rotations — Dev, are you available the week starting 7 July for the US-friendly slot?

Attachments: MediLabs-MutualActionPlan.pdf (draft M.A.P.), technical-deep-dive-agenda.docx

If helpful I can send a provisional recurring invite once you confirm Option A or B and I’ll include timezone-friendly calendar invites.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes

Hi Camila — thanks for the clear options.

Short answers:
- We like Option B (fixed weekday, rotating windows) because our ops calendar is tightly packed and a consistent weekday helps
- Tue works for us as an anchor day
- Maria (cc'd) will confirm engineering availability, but preliminarily APAC team prefers Week 3 slot (the APAC-friendly window)

Maria — can you confirm availability for Tue 00:00–01:30 UTC on the week of 14 July (that corresponds to 10:00–11:30 AEST on Wed 15 July local)? If we can get Dev on one of the first two rotations that'd be ideal.

On attachments — looks good, I'll review the M.A.P. and suggest a small tweak to the post-call action owner list.

Thanks,
